tour.title: Start at the entry points
tour.description: The browser boots from main.tsx and the API from server/src/index.ts. Everything else hangs off these two.
tour.lesson: In a split SPA + API repo, find one entry per runtime before reading anything else.

tour.title: How the API is assembled
tour.description: createApp wires middleware and mounts each router under /api.
tour.lesson: Express middleware runs in registration order; app.use before a router applies to all of its routes.

tour.title: Authentication
tour.description: Login issues a JWT; requireAuth verifies it on every guarded route.

tour.title: Tasks: route → service → repo
tour.description: The core feature follows a three-tier path. Note the raw SQL in taskRepo.searchTasks.
tour.lesson: Prisma's $queryRawUnsafe skips parameterization; prefer the tagged $queryRaw template.

tour.title: The board UI
tour.description: BoardPage loads tasks with useTasks and renders TaskList columns of TaskCards.

tour.title: Shipping it
tour.description: The Dockerfile builds both halves; compose adds Postgres; CI runs tests and builds the image.

findings.title: Shell command built from request data
findings.message: exec() receives a string interpolating boardName from the request body.
findings.triageNote: Endpoint is also unguarded. Use execFile with an argument array.

findings.title: SQL built with string interpolation
findings.message: $queryRawUnsafe called with a template containing the search term.

findings.title: File path joined from route parameter
Outbound request to user-supplied URL
findings.message: fetch() targets a stored webhook URL with no allowlist or private-range block.

findings.title: Hardcoded JWT secret fallback
findings.message: JWT_SECRET falls back to a literal when the env var is missing.

findings.title: MD5 used to hash API tokens
findings.triageNote: Tokens are random 256-bit; tracked for migration to SHA-256.

findings.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML with task description
findings.message: HTML description rendered without visible sanitization.
findings.triageNote: Descriptions are sanitized with DOMPurify on write in createTask.

findings.title: Request body spread into update
findings.message: { ...req.body } passed to updateTaskRow allows setting ownerId.

findings.title: In-memory rate limiter resets per instance
findings.message: Limits are per-process; multiple replicas multiply the allowance.
